text:
toni: heads up — customer reported duplicate token charges when a streaming response hit a truncated toolcall and the client reconnected to a fallback model. seems like provisional + confirmed both billed.
raj: ugh. do we have a repro or logs? any request ids?
toni: yes. request xreq=ab3c. router swapped from pool-a -> pool-b after a circuit-breaker. snippet:```log
[2026-03-19T21:11:02Z] router: route=pool-a xreq=ab3c -> truncated toolcall(search)
[2026-03-19T21:11:04Z] router: fallback to pool-b xreq=ab3c resume_token=rt-77
[2026-03-19T21:11:04Z] serving(pool-b): confirmed_charge session=svc-99 tokens=120
[2026-03-19T21:11:05Z] ledger: provisional_charge session=svc-99 tokens=110
```
lisa: that ledger order is suspicious — provisional after confirmed? how are we ordering provisional vs confirmed writes on route handoff?
raj: currently provisional is written at the stream boundary on the first connection. when fallback happens we treat new connection like a fresh session and write confirmed charges on completion. we don't stitch by resume_token.
morgan: quick mitigation idea: preserve resume_token across router handoffs and include it in the ledger key so the recon job can dedupe. this avoids changing client API.
toni: +1. also console folks will want clearer UI: customers see two line items and assume a bug. devex, can we show "merged provisional" indicator if recon later stitches them?
devex: yes. short-term we can add an expiring banner on the cost page: "Some sessions are pending reconciliation (possible duplicates)." long-term show merged/merged-from route metadata.
lisa: operationally we should also put a 60s TTL on provisional entries and a nightly job that scans for confirmed matches by resume_token or xreq and collapses them into a single invoice record.
raj: two caveats: (1) toolcall retries that are actually new tool executions must still be billable; dedupe must consider toolcall idempotency. (2) interaction with refunds — merging records should keep auditable history.
morgan: agree. telemetry change: inference.events.v2 should add resume_token and prev_route_id and toolcall_id. keep fields optional to be non-breaking.
toni: can someone own a mini-RFC? prefer small incremental pieces: (A) router preserves resume_token header and emits transfer_reason, (B) ledger index includes resume_token when present, (C) reconcile worker merges within TTL, (D) console surface.
raj: i'll own RFC and verification tests. plan: POC on canary env, instrument a reconciler metric, then roll.
devex: i'll mock the banner and the tooltip for transfer_reason values: capacity, preemptive_maintenance, soft_error, circuit_breaker.
ops-bot: Incident created INC-2026-322 assigned eng-platform. https://redwood.ops/incidents/INC-2026-322 :rotating_light:
toni: thanks. follow-ups: raj RFC, morgan telemetry PR, devex UI mock, lisa recon job spike. we'll sync in next standup.
